knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A minimum charge comes from the business's own costs and is written in the policy.
A package must cover its costs at the promised frequency. It is adjusted or refused, not sold at a loss.
Extras are agreed in writing before the work, so the client knows what they pay.

practicalCriteria: Visit price is shown built from its listed costs with the basis for each share
A minimum charge and a chemicals policy are written in the pricing terms
Each extra has a written agreement before the work, and a package is tested against the visit cost
No sample or competitor figure is used as the business's price
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Price published with no cost basis
Extra work done without a written agreement
